Question Choices: A diver moves from a depth of -6.25 meters to a depth of -19.5 meters. Fill in the blanks: the change in depth is -19.5 - ___ = ___.
Hints: Signed change = final value − initial value. Keep the sign of the initial value inside parentheses.
Solution: -19.5 - (-6.25) = -19.5 + 6.25 = -13.25, so the diver descended 13.25 meters. Check: initial value + signed change = final value. A negative change means a decrease. Exact check: -6.25 = -6.25; -19.5-(-6.25) = -13.25.

Question Choices: Starting from 8.4 C, the temperature fell 3.5 C in each of three consecutive hours. What is the temperature now? Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Use plus for gains/deposits and minus for losses/withdrawals; include an initial value only when asked for the final value.
Solution: 3.5 + 3.5 + 3.5 = 10.5, so 8.4 - 10.5 = -2.1. Keep each sign with its change. The final value is the starting value plus all changes; a total profit/debt is a sum of the stated signed amounts. Exact check: 8.4-3*3.5 = -2.1.
